name: Shock lines
summary: Radiating emphasis strokes that pop out around a point and flicker; for surprise, realisation and shock beats.

params.name: r
params.note: inner radius where the strokes start, px

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: color
params.note: stroke colour; default the style ink

author: krakujs
